question: In Table 3, how much lower is the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat than that of the bare material, and how much higher is its onset temperature?
rendered:
According to Table 3, the bare NMC material has an onset temperature of 231.93 °C and a heat generation of 666.42 J/g. The ZrO2 loading with the least heat, 1.0 wt.%, has an onset temperature of 237.59 °C and a heat generation of 487.31 J/g. 

The heat generation of the 1.0 wt.% ZrO2 loading is 666.42 - 487.31 = 179.11 J/g lower than that of the bare material. The onset temperature of the 1.0 wt.% ZrO2 loading is 237.59 - 231.93 = 5.66 °C higher than that of the bare material.
